svg.aria-label: SpotHole, a pothole reporting app. A report runs snap, clarity check, GPS, address, post, track; status goes pending, acknowledged, resolved.

g.text: Report a pothole with one photo, and keep it on
React Native · Expo · Node.js · Express · MongoDB
Snap a pothole: a blurry photo is sent back for a retake, the
GPS location is tagged and turned into an address, and the
report is posted to Twitter so it can't be quietly ignored. Every
report is tracked on a dashboard until the road is fixed.
Report first, sign up later: guests can convert to a full account.
blurry → retake · no GPS → type the address
